params.name: fornsx
params.description: true if network offering is meant to be used for NSX, false otherwise.

params.name: domainid
params.description: The ID of the containing domain(s), null for public offerings

params.name: provider
params.description: Name of the provider providing the service

params.name: internetprotocol
params.description: The internet protocol of the offering. Options are IPv4 and dualstack. Default is IPv4. dualstack will create an offering that supports both IPv4 and IPv6

params.name: servicecapabilitylist
params.description: Desired service capabilities as part of VPC offering

params.name: routingmode
params.description: the routing mode for the VPC offering. Supported types are: Static or Dynamic.

params.name: conservemode
params.description: True if the VPC offering is IP conserve mode enabled, allowing public IPs to be used across multiple VPC tiers. Default value is false

params.name: nsxsupportlb
params.description: true if network offering for NSX VPC offering supports Load balancer service.

params.name: networkmode
params.description: Indicates the mode with which the network will operate. Valid option: NATTED or ROUTED

params.name: specifyasnumber
params.description: true if the VPC offering supports choosing AS number

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the VPC offering

params.name: serviceofferingid
params.description: The ID of the service offering for the VPC router appliance

params.name: zoneid
params.description: The ID of the containing zone(s), null for public offerings

params.name: serviceproviderlist
params.description: Provider to service mapping. If not specified, the provider for the service will be mapped to the default provider on the physical network

params.name: supportedservices
params.description: Services supported by the VPC offering

params.name: displaytext
params.description: The display text of the VPC offering, defaults to the 'name'

params.name: enable
params.description: Set to true if the offering is to be enabled during creation. Default is false

response.name: fornsx
